## workers

### A worker count fixed in a committed hook (-n auto) is per-core on the host that runs it

**Rule.** Substitute the computed count in the local runner (a temp copy of the hook config), keep the committed config for CI, and bound concurrent full runs host-wide

**Why.** B26b5951f2b: 2-3 CI-parity runs of 192 workers each gave load 337

### Machine-local gates.toml pins -n 24, so the {workers} default never reaches the unit_tests gate here; /tmp/claude-1001 shared names clash between agents

**Rule.** Put {workers} in .ddflow/local/gates.toml to use the computed count; write scratch output under the session scratchpad, never /tmp/claude-1001/<name>

**Why.** rd.out was overwritten by another agent's review

## workflow

### Confirm an enabled different-family reviewer exists before the critic gates, not at completion

**Rule.** Before starting the critic/rubber_duck gates, run `ddflow reviewers list` and confirm there is an ENABLED reviewer whose family differs from the author's. A reviewer with `gates = []` is disabled; roborev (or any same-family reviewer) does not satisfy the independence check even when it reviews the diff, and `ddflow complete` refuses on it with "--force overrides". If no different-family reviewer is enabled, ask the operator up front whether to enable one or to accept the coverage gap, rather than discovering it at completion time.

**Why.** On B-dupes-sweep the only enabled reviewer (lan-deepseek-v4.1-flash) was the author's own family, and the alibaba Qwen was disabled by the operator's local config (gates = []). Three roborev rounds and a full suite were run before `complete` refused on independence, forcing a `--force` the operator had to authorize mid-task.

**Seen in:** B-dupes-sweep

## worktree

### Never git stash in a worktree: the stash stack is shared by every worktree and agent

**Rule.** Set work aside with a WIP commit, never git stash or stash pop

**Why.** refs/stash is one stack for the primary checkout and all linked worktrees; another lane's pop applies or drops your entry (or you take theirs)

**How to apply.** Use a temporary WIP commit; if a stash is unavoidable use stash push -u -m with a unique tag, capture its SHA, restore with stash apply SHA, drop by re-finding the tag

**Seen in:** P-unify

### A branch cut before a config knob cannot commit until it merges main: merge with --no-commit first

**Rule.** When a salvaged/stale worktree's commit hook dies with 'unknown knob' on the primary's .ddflow/config.toml, set the uncommitted work aside as a patch, run 'git merge main --no-commit', commit the merge, then re-apply and commit the work.

**Why.** The hook runs 'python -m ddflow', which puts the worktree's cwd first on sys.path, so the branch's OLD ddflow code reads the primary's NEWER config and refuses the unknown knob on every commit, including the salvage commit (B-precommit-companion, 2026-09-29; B9cb7dd1c3b fixed tolerance only for code containing the fix).

### A baseline test run must use a tree nobody is editing

**Rule.** Take the 'before' suite run in a separate detached worktree of the base, never in the worktree you are about to change.

**Why.** On the run_nemo_run cutover a 13-minute baseline ran in the cutover worktree while the rulebooks were being edited; doc-reading tests picked up the edits mid-run and the baseline reported failures the base does not have (67 vs 57 on a clean run).

**How to apply.** git worktree add --detach <path> <base>; run the baseline there; diff failure sets by node id.

### A gate command is read from the primary checkout but runs with the item branch's dependencies: merge main before unit_tests after the gate config changes

**Rule.** Before running the unit_tests gate, merge the base branch into the item branch whenever main changed .ddflow/config.toml's gate commands or the dev dependencies (e.g. the pytest-xdist '-n 48' change, 8fe68e6).

**Why.** load_gates reads the primary .ddflow/config.toml, but the command executes in the item's worktree with that branch's pyproject.toml/uv.lock; a branch cut before pytest-xdist was added fails with 'unrecognized arguments: -n 48'.

**How to apply.** git merge main in the item worktree (uv run then syncs the new dev deps), rerun the gate.

**Seen in:** B-parallel-tests

## worktrees

### ddflow copies .roborev.toml into each worktree at creation: changing the primary's reviewer pin leaves older worktrees on the old model

**Rule.** After changing .roborev.toml (model, backup) or a served model name, update the copies in existing worktrees (.ddflow/worktrees/*/.roborev.toml), then check a fresh job's model in 'roborev list --json'.

**Why.** 2026-10-19: the LAN Flash host renamed its model (…-Flash-1017); worktrees created earlier still pinned the old name, so roborev job 3107 failed with ProviderModelNotFoundError and standards went unavailable. Fixed 5 stale copies by hand.

**How to apply.** Bug Bbc4f952ca9 tracks the root cause; the fix is to resolve the roborev config from the primary at job time, not a frozen copy.
